scope: Additive Study Statistician decision evidence layered on the validated v0.23 analysis package; no new TLF, no replacement of the primary model, and no formal sponsor/regulatory claim.
interpretation_boundary: The suite demonstrates three distinct decision contexts: prospective planning, exposure-based safety summarisation and post-data-review analysis governance.
Component PASS means the controlled portfolio checks passed; it does not establish sponsor/CRO production experience or regulatory acceptance.
The existing T01-T25 analysis package remains the inherited controlled evidence base.
